subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Fake Online Reviews
description: A 60-second lesson on Fake Online Reviews.

hook.text: A product has 4.8 stars and 10,000 reviews. Most of them were written by paid strangers.

buildup.text: Companies pay review farms to generate hundreds of five-star reviews overnight.

discovery.text: An estimated 40% of online reviews are fake — paid, incentivized, or written by bots.

twist.text: Amazon, Google, and Yelp remove millions of fake reviews yearly, but new ones appear faster.

climax.text: Consumers rely on reviews more than ever, making fake reviews more valuable than ever.

punchline.text: Stars can be bought. Trust can't.

quiz.question: What percentage of online reviews is estimated to be fake?
